tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gsang thig skor gsum las/ rdor sems phyag rgya gcig pa'i phrin las gnas lung dang bcas pa ye shes bcud thig ces bya ba bzhugs so//

mi phyed stong nyid rdo rje dang*// snying rje'i sems dpas rigs thams cad// sdom mdzad dngos kun khyab bdag la// phyag byas phrin las snying po bsdeb// 'di la brten nas phrin las kyi cho ga nyung ngus bdag don tshogs gsag dang*/ gzhan don gnas lung bya bar 'dod pas mdun bskyed rten bris sku sogs yod na de tsam gyis 'thus shing*/ med na maṇḍa lar tshom bu gcig dgod/ gnyis ka ma 'dzom na mdun mkhar yid kyis bsgoms pas kyang 'thus/ gang ltar bla gtor zlum po rgyan ldan gyi g.yas g.yon du sman raka /phyi mchod mdun du bsham/ bsang chu dang tshogs kyi yo byad gang 'byor bsags/ byang chog byed na maṇḍal mdun du bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings can dang*/ bgegs gtor/ bye til yungs dkar/ mtshan byang*/ zas bsngo mar me sogs 'du bya/ thog mar skyabs sems nas brtsam bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa gsang thig gter gzhung rtsa ba bzhin grub nas/ mdun bskyed phrin las kyi thog mar bsang chu la dmigs te/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dmar po/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro mo dbyings phyug ma dmar mo dril bu dang bhan dmar 'dzin pa'i skur gyur par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg la/ oṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa rī sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ya oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī ṭhā/ zhes brgya'am nyer gcig tsam gyis byin brlabs nas/ khro mo dbyings phyug ma'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams mchog: rin chen gzhal med khang dang bcas: rgyan bkod longs spyod phun sum tshogs: bhrūm̐ las bhañdza'i snod rnams su: oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod pa'i sprin: sman raka gtor gsum phyi nang gsang:

rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā a mṛta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā rakta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: zhes sngags rnams lan gsum brjod la byin brlab/ oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ chos rnams stong pa'i ngang nyid las: mdun du 'byung ba ri rab steng: padma 'dab ma stong ldan dbus: bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: dal dbus seng khri padma dang: nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐ yig ni: rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par gsal: 'od 'phros rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus: 'gro ba'i las sgrib ma lus sbyangs: rdo rje sems dpa'i sa la bkod: tshur 'dus yongs gyur skad cig la: mdun mkhar bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar po zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum: dbu skra thor tshugs rin chen brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas dril bu dku la brten: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: mtshan bzang dpe byad thams cad rdzogs: zi ldir dar dpyang cod pan dang: stod g.yogs smad g.yogs mdzes par dkris: dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan dang: se mo do dang do shal dang: gdu bu rnams kyis legs par brgyan: pang du rdo rje snyems ma dkar: bcu drug lang tsho gri thod can: phyag rgya lnga 'chang yab dang 'khril: 'od 'bar klong du lham mer bskyed: spyi bor oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can: spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings su snyoms zhugs pa'i: rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyang: gzugs sku rdo rje sems dpar bzhengs: thugs rjes nye bar 'dir gshegs gsol: badzra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis med bstim: hūm̐: ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' che: byang chub bar du legs bzhugs shing:

mtha' yas 'gro rnams sgrol mdzad pa'i: bde gshegs gtso la phyag 'tshal lo: tiṣṭha lhan: na mo hūm̐: thugs las mchod pa'i lha mo spros te: hūm̐: bsod nams rgya mtsho las byung ba'i: nam mkha'i mtha' klas ye shes kyi: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang: bdug spos snang gsal dri bzang chab: zhal zas rol mo bsam yas pa: rdor sems sras dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ pa na peṃ pe nu su ra te ti pu sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma yo gi siddhi hūm̐: oṃ gu ru badzra satwa arghaṃ sogs nas shabda pū dza ho: hūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang: rgyal srid bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs: kun bzang mchod sprin chen po yis: bla ma rdor sems mnyes gyur cig: na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: hūm̐: ye shes tshad med dpa' bo'i phud: bde ba chen po'i dmar chen po: 'dod yon gtor ma'i sprin phung rnams: bla ma rdo rje sems la 'bul: ma hā a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: thabs shes bde stong rol pa yis: gnyis med rnal 'byor dgyes pa bskyed: ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bdud: rang gsal dmigs med bsgral bas mchod: mchod dang mchod bya mi dmigs kyang: rang rtsal lhun grub mnyes pa che: ma hā su kha ta na ga ṇa dharma dhā tu pū dza ho: don la rdo rje'i glu yis bstod pa ni: hūm̐: mi g.yo shes rab chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje thabs mkhas sprul pa'i sku: dbyer med rdo rje sems la 'dud: dri med dung mdog mtshan dpe rdzogs: snang stong gnyis med rdor dril 'dzin: rdo rje snyems mar mnyam sbyor ba: phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems la 'o: de nas bzlas pa ni: thugs kar padma zla ba'i steng: rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i: lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i: hūm̐ yig mtha' ru yig brgyas bskor: 'od zer bsam yas 'phros pa yis:

sdig sgrib bag chags nad gdon sbyangs: bde gshegs rnams la mnyes mchod phul: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus: bla ma yi dam mnyes par byas: mched lcam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: chos skyong srung ma'i 'khon sbyangs shing: phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la bskul: bdud dang bgegs kyi sdang sems zhi: 'gro ba'i las sgrib ma lus sbyangs: snod bcud rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing: lha sngags ye shes rol par gyur: ces mos la yig brgya dang yig drug ci nus bzla/ bdag 'jug dang*/ gnas lung byed na skabs 'dir gter gzhung ltar bum bskyed bzlas pa dbang len dang bcas pa bya/ 'dir gnas lung dang tshogs mchod dkyus ma tsam la ma byas kyang chog mod/ nyams chag skong bshags mdor bsdus sbyar bar spro na/ ye shes sku mchog dang yig brgya brjod la phyag 'tshal/ mar me sbar la/ oṃ: kun gzhi gsang ba chen po'i dbyings: rang rig gsal ba'i mdangs shar ba: ye shes chen po'i mar me 'dis: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang bla ma dang: rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro'i nyams chag sbyang: rdo rje'i g.yar dam gcig pa rnams: dgyes pa chen po'i mchod par 'bul: snang ba 'od gsal sprin chen pos: sprul pa'i sku yi thugs dam bskang: bum dbang dam tshig nyams chag bshags: rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs: stong pa ngos bzung med pa 'dis: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs dam bskang: gsang dbang dam tshig nyams chag bshags: rdo rje'i sngags su byin gyis rlobs: zung 'jug shin tu rnam dag pas: chos kyi sku yi thugs dam bskang: sher dbang dam tshig nyams chag bshags: rdo rje'i thugs su byin gyis rlobs: dbyer med thig le chen po yis: ngo bo nyid sku'i thugs dam bskang: tshig dbang dam tshig nyams chag bshags: ye shes rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: zhes dzap dbyangs bya zhing 'og gi gnas lung la 'jug

/de dag mi byed na gong gi bzlas pa grub ma thag tshogs mchod bya ba ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis ma dag sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ yig las: dbyings kyi bhandha yangs pa'i nang: phung khams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: me rlung sbyor bas 'od du zhu: 'bru gsum 'od kyis ye shes lnga'i: bdud rtsi spyan drangs gnyis med thim: 'dod yon mchod sprin spro bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir: rang snang 'dod yon mchod sprin spro: bla ma rdo rje sems la sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ badzra satwa sogs/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: bar pa bshags pa ni/ ho: thog med dus nas bsags pa yi: las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa'i tshogs: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: sa ma ya shuddhe a: hūm̐: bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: mchod pa rgya mtsho 'di bzhes shig: nyams chag rgya mtsho ma lus bshags: thugs dam rgya mtsho ma lus bskangs: dngos grub rgya mtsho bstsal du gsol: phrin las rgya mtsho ma lus sgrubs: tshig rkang phyi ma drug po tshar grangs grub na thams cad kyi don 'dus pas legs/ tha ma bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: rang snang 'khrul pa'i dug gsum dgra bgegs rnams: rnam thar gsum du ye shes chen pos bsgral: bag chags sbyangs pa'i ye shes tshogs mchod 'di: bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi zhal du bstabs: ma traṃ ru dra mā ra ya phaṭa: māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: gal te tshogs 'bum ther la sogs gsag dgos pa'i tshe 'di yan song nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin brlab/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥs pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ zhes 'bul/ hūm̐: bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: sogs gong gsal tshig rkang drug pos skong bshags bya ste de la grangs bzung ngo// brda'i 'bul len bcas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bdud rtsis bran la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis brlab/ bhyo: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud rnams: 'dod yon bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin du: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes phyir 'bul/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang*/ yig brgya/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyi bzod gsol/ rten yod na spyi mthun brtan bzhugs byas kyang chog la/ med na/ mdun bskyed rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bstim: snang srid 'od zhu rten dang brten par thim: srung 'khor 'byung ba gzhal yas khang dang khri: dngos po rgyan rnams yab yum so sor thim: yab yum 'od zhu rdo rje sngags phreng la: de yang hūm̐ la hūm̐ yang nā da'i bar: de nyid mi dmigs ka dag ngang la bzhag: slar yang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ru langs: zhes 'od gsal 'jug ldang bya/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dgongs: 'di ltar dge spyad bsod nams gang: mtha' yas sems can rnams la bsngo: sgrib gnyis kun zad yon tan rdzogs: 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen 'byor: bla med byang chub gnas thob shog: ces bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad gang rung brjod pas 'grub bo// 'di la brten nas gnas lung bya bar 'dod na/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa grub mtshams/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥnṛ aṅgu sha dza: bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros/ tshe 'das dngos su bkug nas mdun du 'khod pa la/ bdag mdun gyi gnas gsum nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag par gyur/ yig brgya'am yig drug sham du/ tri tirya ka da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭ: pre pre ta ka pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭ: du na ra ka ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ: ces bzlas shing bye yungs la'ang phus gdab/ de nas bum bskyed bzlas pa dbang len bcas grub pa dang mtshan byang mdun du bzhag par bsang chus bran la/

oṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa rī sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭ: oṃ swa bhā ba sogs kyis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng*// nṛ las tshe 'das lha yi gzugs// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// rnam shes a dkar rnam pas thim// na mo dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden stobs dang*// bcom ldan thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe 'das rnam shes gar gnas kyang*// dmigs pa'i rten 'dir mchis gyur cig /nṛ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes pas rnam shes dgug / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa rten la bstim/ bgegs gtor raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlab/ oṃ sarba bighnān ā karṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron dgug / oṃ sarba bighnān ba liṃ ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ hūm̐: yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: tshe 'das thar lam bar chad bdud: he ru ka dpal bka' byung bas: brlag par 'gyur gyis gzhan du song: drag sngags dang yungs thun gyis bskrad/ badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ dmigs yul tha mal gnas pa yi: gsang bar dmyal ba'i sa bon du: snying gar yi dwags sa bon pre: lte bar dud 'gro'i sa bon tri: so so'i steng du raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: slob dpon rdor sems gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i 'od kyis slob ma yi: gnas gsum sa bon gsum gyi steng: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ bskul me rlung chus: sa bon bag chags bsregs gtor bkrus: slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' yi: phyag g.yas nyi ma la gnas pa'i: sor mo oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: g.yon pa zla ba la gnas pa'i: sor mo mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: rigs lnga yab yum skur gyur pa: oṃ su ra ta st+waṃ: badzra añdza li: badzra bhandha baṃ: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba yis: dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ru: skye ba'i sdig sgrib sa bon sbyangs: thal mo gzeng bskum phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bi shuddhe bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā:

yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ na ra ka: pre ta ka: tirya ka: tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭ: de nas 'gyod bshags dang sdom sems ni/ kye ma kyi hud rdo rje 'dzin: 'gro mgon thugs rjes bdag skyobs shig: dbang mchog rgyal po bsgrag tu gsol: slad nas mi 'chab mi sbed do: bla mas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ bu 'dir shog cig rigs kyi bu: rang gi nyams dang 'das nyams kyis: na raka gnas su ltung ba las: skyob phyir dbang mchog sbyin par bya: sngags kyis btab pa'i bye ma dang yungs dkar rnams kyis ming byang brab/ yig brgya'i mthar/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ: oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ: oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ: bum pas dbang bskur zhing khrus byas la/ hūm̐: til gyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i: rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni: de nyid du ni blugs mdzad pas: bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig: yig brgya'i mthar/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang: 'dod chags: gti mug gi sgo nas bsags pa'i dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gror skye ba'i sdig sgrib thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor/ nye du la sogs pas phyag 'tshal te/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku / sogs shlo ka gcig / mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// sogs gsum/ bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems// bde chen ye shes lnga yi bdag /dkyil 'khor kun gyi byed po mchog /de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa sogs dang*/ skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun// 'khor ba ngan song 'jigs las sgrol// thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol// zhes brjod/ tshe 'das skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ bum pas dbang bskur la/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi bum pa na: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i lha tshogs bzhugs: sprul pa'i chu yis dbang bskur bas: nyon dag ye shes thob par shog: yig brgya'i mthar/ dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bskur/ bza' btung rnams chus bran/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlabs la/ oṃ: thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du: zad pa med pa'i longs spyod ni: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin chen po: bzhes shig bde ba chen por bzhes: oṃ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe ra sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: zhes bsngo/ lam sbyong bstan sogs ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: dang po skyes kyang las las skyes: 'chi ba'i rang bzhin bslu med kyang: yang dag don la skye 'chi bral: khyod kyang byang chub sems skyed la: rang rig rdo rje sems dpa' yi: rang ngo shes pas rdor sems dang: dbyer med da lta sangs rgyas 'gyur: a la la ste ngo mtshar che: bu khyod thar pa'i lam du gshegs: phaṭ: dmigs yul gyi rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ a zhes brjod la mnyam par bzhag / rdor sems kyi thugs ka nas ye shes 'od zer me'i rnam pa 'phros te bag chags kyi rten sbyang bar gyur/

hūm̐/ ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas: tshe 'das dug lnga'i phung po dang: sdig sgrib nyon mongs bud shing bsregs: dbyings ye zung 'jug sangs rgyas shog: yig brgya'i sham du sarba pā paṃ bi shuddhe dzwa la raṃ: zhes btags pa bzla zhing lta ba'i ngang bskyangs la byang bu bsreg /thal bas sātstsha gdab/ smon lam ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ de nas tshogs yod na tshogs la 'jug cing*/ med na mchod bstod sogs rjes chog byas pas 'grub bo// nongs pa bshags shing rnam dkar mthus// mkha' mthas gtugs pa'i skye rgu rnams// dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang// dbyer med mngon par byang chub shog /ces pa 'di'ang nye bar gnas pa karma nor 'phel sogs don gnyer can gyi ngor dang*/ rang gzhan la nyer mkho 'jug bde'i ched du 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa rtsal gyis dpal spungs dben khrod du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
